bosses.name: Xieshi
bosses.strategy:
His Flaming Arm of Death spell will hit your party for a decent amount of
damage, but also can Silence your party, so having Bell Bracelets
equipped definitely helps a ton. You don't want to be stuck with NO
healing abilities at all!

I strongly recommend fusing Yuri in the Man Dragon Fusion if you have it,
as not only is the enemy fire-based, but you'll be able to heal yourself
in a pinch, if need be. Have Yuri use the Flash Flood skill repeatedly,
and it should do massive damage each round. If you don't have Man Dragon,
then fuse into Raging Tiger and cast Flying Stones to do some decent
damage.

Zhuzhen should be healing pretty much the entire time. If he does have a
free round, have him use Ogre Flamedance, since it'll still do some okay
damage, even though the boss is fire-based.

bosses.name: Baigu
bosses.strategy:
His Shining Arm of Death spell will hit your party for a decent amount of
damage, but also can Paralyze your party, so having Rosewood Bracelets
equipped definitely helps a ton. You don't want to be stuck with NO
healing abilities at all!

Not much of a strategy here, since there's only one thing you can do:
Attack. Have Alice be the preferred healer, using Thera Seeds and such,
since her attack is the weakest. Keep hammering away, and as long as you
stay healed, Baigu will eventually fall.

bosses.name: Qinggu
bosses.strategy:
Hopefully you equipped the Pocket Watch on Yuri so that his Judgment Ring
is unaffected.

No strategy at all here, since all you can do is Attack and Defend. Just
battle back and forth until you eventually win. If you've become
proficient with your Judgment Ring, try equipping the Flash Badge on Yuri

bosses.name: Yamaraja: War
bosses.strategy:
As with Wugui, Yamaraja: War will absorb all magic, making Zhuzhen useful
only as a healer. He also uses the Game of Death, just like Wugui; if you
don't have those Leonardo's Bears equipped to everyone, they'll have a
chance to instantly kill you. His Nightmare attack will hit the entire
party for a lot of damage, so make sure heal afterward. The only other
thing he does is a hellacious physical attack that'll hit for major
damage. Once he starts using Nightmare repeatedly, you could be in a bit
of trouble.

Have Yuri fuse into Inferno and cast Fighting Spirit on himself, followed
by physically attacking Yamaraja every turn. Margarete should be
attacking normally, but having her jump in to use Thera Seeds if needed,
and Zhuzhen should focus completely on recovery.

If you're having trouble staying healed, have Yuri fuse into Heaven's
Fiend so you have the whole party healing spell.

notes.text: The Temple Ruins actually have an enemy of every class here, so if for some reason you don't have all of the level 1 Fusions like I recommended earlier, make sure to use this place to get enough Soul Energy to get the Fusions.

The Courier Subordinate has Leonardo's Bears for sale. You will find two here in the dungeon, but make ABSOLUTELY SURE that you buy one more for your active party, as the last boss here WILL use Instant Death attacks.
Xiaofang has a shop as well. As I mentioned before, make sure to buy an additional Leonardo's Bear if you haven't already.

Make sure that Zhuzhen is at least level 12 and has the NourishingPotion spell learned so that he has healing capabilities. Also, you should invest in a second Bell Bracelet for the upcoming battle to prevent Silence.

Monsters defeated while Yuri isn't in the party DOES count toward his Soul Energy, so if you're wanting the Light Fusion, you can fight plenty of Raging Spirits here to get it. Also, the Malice meter will not build when Yuri's not in the party.

If you don't have enough already, you should invest in two Rosewood Bracelets for the upcoming boss battle to prevent Paralysis. NOTE     You won't get to control Alice again after the battle, and she'll be
Make sure that Yuri has the Pocket Watch equipped for the next battle.
This is the last time Xiaofang appears with a shop, so if you haven't yet, buy one Leonardo's Bear so that you will have three in the last boss battle of this area.

Make your way into the Temple itself after a bit of dialogue. Move forward to
the stage area in the center, but before examining the statue, check around the
left pillar to find a chest containing a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Afterward, examine
the statue to have Zhuzhen try to remember the rites to unlock the temple's
entrance. Make your way west to the next area, then continue along to find a
Save Point and a chest; open the chest for a [_TALISMANOFMERCY_]. Use the Save
Point, and talk both the Smuggler Boss, as well as the Courier Subordinate, who
you can do some shopping with, if needed. After doing that, go back and talk to
Zhuzhen to continue.

  NOTE     The Courier Subordinate has Leonardo's Bears for sale. You will find
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   two here in the dungeon, but make ABSOLUTELY SURE that you buy one
           more for your active party, as the last boss here WILL use
           Instant Death attacks.

Zhuzhen will unlock the passage, so go down the stairs to the next area. Follow
the path and you'll arrive in a small room with a Save Point and two doors.
After some dialogue, your party will be split into two groups; Yuri and
Zhuzhen, and Alice and Margarete. Your items will also be sealed in battle, so
make sure to do any healing outside of battle.

  NOTE     Xiaofang has a shop as well. As I mentioned before, make sure to buy
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   an additional Leonardo's Bear if you haven't already.

  NOTE     CLEAR YOUR MALICE BEFORE STARTING.
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Use the Save Point, then enter the trial. Open the chest here for a [_TENT_],
then continue to the next area. Continue following the path until you reach the
Warp Point; press the CROSS button to warp to another area. Move east to the
next screen, then east to another, where you'll find an empty treasure chest.
Keep going to the next screen, where you'll be at a fork in the path with a
chest containing a [_BRONZE ARROWHEAD_] inside. Ignore the north and east paths
since they lead to each other, then take the western path to a yellow Warp
Point, using it to warp to the next section of the maze.

Xiaofang is here this time, so feel free to buy some items if you like, then
head north to the next area. Continue north to an empty chest, then keep right
on going to the next screen. There'll be a full chest here this time, so grab
the [_TEAOFTHEHEALER_] out of it and keep going. At the fork here, take the top
eastern path first, where you'll find a [_W.TIGER HAIR_]. Back at the fork,
north leads to a dead-end, so take the lower western path to find yet another
chest, this time with a [_BRONZE DAGGER_].

Make your way south to the next area, opening an empty chest in this area.
Continue west to the next area to another fork. Head south first, opening the
chest here for a whole lot of NOTHING, then head south to the next screen for a
[_TALISMANOFMERCY_]. Ignore the path to the west and head back to the last
fork, taking the north path to the next screen.

Open the chest here for a [_MANA SEED_], then take the western path from this
room to find a [_BELL BRACELET_], which you should immediately equip to
Zhuzhen. Go back to the fork one last time and head north to the next screen.
If you like, head one screen east and open the empty chest here, otherwise,
ignore that entire direction, as it leads to the last area I had you ignore.
Head west to the next area, then north at the fork here (since south is a dead-
end), and you'll finally come across a red Warp Point that'll take you to the
next section of the maze.

  NOTE     Make sure that Zhuzhen is at least level 12 and has the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   NourishingPotion spell learned so that he has healing capabilities.
           Also, you should invest in a second Bell Bracelet for the upcoming
           battle to prevent Silence.

Talk/shop with Xiaofang if needed, then head all the way north until you reach
a room. Use the Save Point, then examine the altar to find a glowing gem. Do
you wish to put your hand in front of it?

the northern path to find another chest containing a [_B.TORTOISE FANG_].
Ignore the southern path, taking the western path instead to the next screen.
Ignore the fork to the north as well, as it leads to the last area, and make
your way west and south, using the yellow Warp Point to go to the next area.

Xiaofang's here if you need him. The next screen to the east has a fork; make
your way south, then south again to another fork. Open the chest to the south

end containing a [_VOODOO DOLL_].

Head back to the last screen and take the eastern path to be at a four-way
fork. Ignore the southern path and take the eastern path, opening an empty
treasure chest in the next area. Continue along to the next area for another
chest; this one has a [_SILVER HOURGLASS_]. Keep going to the next area.

At this four-way fork, open the chest for an extra little bit of nothing.
Ignore the northern path, unless you want explore the area and open an empty
chest at a dead-end. Head west first, continuing west once more to a fork. Open
the empty chest here if you like, then move north, opening the chest in this
